tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search published real estate listings on Objelio. Pass structured criteria (preferred) or the user's request as text. tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full published details of one listing: description, features, energy certificate, commission (Courtage), the offering agent and the link to the listing page.

tools.name: explain_criteria
tools.description: Shows how Objelio understands a search request in words, as structured criteria the user can check and correct before searching. Does not search.

tools.description: Compares two or three listings from search_listings side by side: price, price per square meter, estimated purchase costs, area, rooms, building, energy certificate, features and agent.
